INTERNATIONAL SECURITY NOTICE UAS FLIGHT RESTRICTION IN U.S.
   TERRITORY ADJACENT TO THE SOUTH BORDER. THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL
   AVIATION ADMINISTRATION (FAA) HAS ISSUED A TEMPORARY FLIGHT
   RESTRICTION (TFR) CLASSIFIED AS NATIONAL DEFENSE AIRSPACE.
    
   PILOTS AND AIRCRAFT THAT DO NOT ADHERE TO THE ESTABLISHED PROCEDURES
   MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED, AND INTERROGATED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT AND
   SECURITY PERSONNEL OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.
    
   ALL REMOTELY PILOTED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS (UAS / DRONES) OPERATIONS ARE
   PROHIBITED FROM THE SURFACE UP TO 400 FEET AGL WITHIN THE 1 NAUTICAL
   MILE STRIP NORTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER BOUNDARY BETWEEN MEXICO
   AND THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.
   
   1. THIS RESTRICTION EXPRESSLY EXCLUDES THE SOVEREIGN AIRSPACE OF THE
   UNITED MEXICAN STATES. 
   2. UAS OPERATORS REQUIRING ACCESS TO SUCH RESTRICTED AIRSPACE MUST
   COORDINATE AND OBTAIN PRIOR APPROVAL FROM U.S. CUSTOMS AND BORDER
   PROTECTION (CBP) AT LEAST 48 HOURS IN ADVANCE VIA EMAIL:
   SWBDRONEZONEWAIVERS@CBP.DHS.GOV
   3. BE ADVISED THAT UNITED STATES AUTHORITIES ARE AUTHORIZED TO
   INTERFERE, DISRUPT, CONFISCATE, OR DESTROY UNAUTHORIZED UAS THAT POSE
   A THREAT. 
   4. AIR OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO CONSULT CURRENT DETAILS ON THE
   WEBSITE HTTPS://TFR.FAA.GOV BEFORE CONDUCTING ANY OPERATION IN THE
   BORDER ZONE.
